overall: The AG found an individual violation, not a Council-wide one: one councillor's calls and texts reached a quorum of six councillors about a board appointment before a posted meeting. Ordered compliance, release of the communications within 45 days, and certification.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the council deliberated outside a posted meeting about a board appointment, through calls and texts among councillors before the November 18 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find an individual violation of the Open Meeting Law when Councillor Colón Hayes deliberated with other Councillors, reaching a quorum of the Council.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
Release within 45 days of the letter's date of written communications, including emails and text messages, exchanged by Councillors about filling the Voke Committee vacancy.
Council to certify to the AG's office that it has released the communications as ordered.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. We also order the release within forty-five (45) days of the date of this letter of any written communication, including emails and text messages, exchanged by Councillors about filling the Voke Committee vacancy left by the passing of Mr. Holland.
